pool.text: Construction began on Nouakchott to enlarge the village and house fifteen thousand people.
Nouakchott started with its founding by indigenous people from the surrounding region.
The French granted independence and the basics of Nouakchott were completed.
The city of Nouakchott was initially divided into four different departments.
The Polisario Front attacked Nouakchott twice during the Western Sahara conflict.
Official censuses showed that Nouakchott had a population of 134,000 residents.
Madrid, Spain formed a twinning relationship with Nouakchott.
The current nine departments were created in Nouakchott.
Official census figures showed that Nouakchott had 393,325 residents.
Nouakchott became a region of Mauritania after formerly being a district.
Three-quarters of service sector enterprises were located in Nouakchott.
Amman, Jordan established a twinning partnership with Nouakchott.
Lanzhou, China established a twinning connection with Nouakchott.
The government of Mauritania announced a process of clearing the slum on the outskirts.
The Sheikh Zayed solar power plant was completed to respond to electricity demand.
East Jerusalem, Palestine was twinned with the city of Nouakchott.
The census showed a population of 958,399 people in Nouakchott.
It was reported that slums have been replaced by social dwellings for the poorest.
Nouakchott was split into three current regions.
A paper published in PLOS One estimated future climate scenarios for Nouakchott.
